hero.kicker: MapForAll, ikarita igaragara ibyo umujyi wibagiwe.
hero.title: Shaka ubucuruzi buto n’ahantu abafite ubumuga bashobora kuhagera hafi yawe.
hero.body: MapForAll ibanza kwerekana abacuruzi b’aho n’ahantu abafite ubumuga bashobora kwinjira — si gusa amaduka manini asanzwe agaragara. Ahantu hatabonetse hongewaho n’abaturage mu masegonda make.

about.quote: Iduka rito, metero 50. Ridagaragara kuri izindi porogaramu. Rigaragara kuri MapForAll.
about.body: Ubucuruzi nyabwo bw’aho n’ahantu abafite ubumuga bashobora kuhagera, byongeweho n’abaturage kandi bigenzurwa, bishyirwa imbere kubera ko ari ingenzi.
about.aerialAlt: Imisozi ya Kigali iva mu kirere

work.title: Kuva mu gihishwe ujya mu kigaragara
work.body: Buri bucuruzi ni ingenzi. MapForAll iha umwanya ahantu izindi porogaramu zibagirwa.

demo.title: Reba MapForAll ishakisha umujyi
demo.body: Baza ibyo ushaka mu magambo asanzwe. MapForAll ibona ubucuruzi bw’aho n’ahantu abafite ubumuga bashobora kuhagera hafi yawe, buri kamwe gafite ikimenyetso. Nta hantu havumburwa. Byose bigenzurwa n’abaturage.

a11y.deviceDesc: Urugero: usaba iduka abafite ubumuga bashobora kwinjiramo hafi ya Kimisagara, MapForAll igusubiza Duka rya Jean, ifite irembo ridafite esikaliye, iminota 4 ugenda n’amaguru.

hero2.sub: Ubucuruzi buto n’ahantu abafite ubumuga bashobora kuhagera hafi yawe, byongeweho kandi bigenzurwa n’abaturage.

talk.ask: Shaka iduka abafite ubumuga bashobora kwinjiramo hafi ya Kimisagara
talk.answer: Nabonye ahantu 3. Duka rya Jean rifite irembo ridafite esikaliye, iminota 4 n’amaguru.

stats.title: Yakorewe umujyi wose.
stats.s2: ahantu hahimbwe. Buri hantu hagenzurwa n’abaturage.
stats.s3: Iduka rituranye nawe, ubu riri ku ikarita.

bento.title: Ikarita yumva. Kandi igasubiza.
bento.localBody: Iduka ryo mu gace kawe riza imbere y’amaduka manini.
bento.accessBody: Inzira z’abafite ubumuga, imiryango migari, ubwiherero bubakwiriye: byemejwe n’abahajya.
bento.voiceBody: Andika cyangwa uvuge ibyo ushaka, nk’uko wabibwira inshuti.
bento.trustBody: Buri cyemezo gituma ikarita irushaho kwizerwa kuri bose.

how.title: Intambwe eshatu. Nta kuzenguruka.
how.s1Body: Andika ibyo ushaka, mu Kinyarwanda, mu Gifaransa cyangwa mu Cyongereza.
how.s2Body: Ubucuruzi bw’aho n’ahantu abafite ubumuga bashobora kuhagera biza mbere, byagenzuwe n’abaturage.
how.s3Body: Inzira y’amaguru, irembo ryoroshye, amasaha: byose biriteguye.

access2.title: Ubugerwaho, urebye rimwe.
access2.body: Buri hantu herekana neza ibyagenzuwe. Urabimenya mbere yo kujyayo.

final.title: Umujyi wawe uragutegereje.
final.body: Shakisha, ongeraho, sangiza. Buri hantu ni ingenzi.
